scope: Required v0.1 capabilities; no feature removed by an implementation decision
rules: A replacement design must preserve capabilities and prove them.
An upstream PR is a dependency proposal, not delivered Connect functionality.
Open gate assignment is a planning gap, not permission to omit the feature.

features.required_capability: Durable identity, discovery, two-way messaging and offline recovery
features.status: local acceptance passed

features.required_capability: Queryable runtime availability, distinct from identity and declared capabilities
features.status: Gate 3 qualifies expiring available/unavailable/unknown state and one bounded preferred route. Multi-endpoint registry, schedules and fallback remain backlog decisions.
features.required_evidence: Define freshness, offline versus unknown and authorized discovery/update in G3-A; demonstrate runtime availability in G3-E. Broader preferences remain a B-001 scope decision.
features.decision: B-001: retain original availability requirement; decide scope and gate separately for broader endpoint/preferences proposal

features.required_capability: Downloadable v0.1, supported SDK packaging and release qualification
features.status: not released
features.required_evidence: Independent installation, source/dependency identity, compatibility and recovery

features.required_capability: Cross-channel conversation continuity and explicit assistant context transfer
features.status: Gate 3 qualifies retained source history, bounded context delivery, final voice observations and actual four-route decision recall after restart. Omission and ASR/model limits are explicit; SMS-to-native SDK recall is now verified in the same conversation; task resumption remains Gate 4 work.
features.required_evidence: Share a draft and a meaningful fact in native messaging/chat; start a voice Session in that Conversation; prove the assistant can use that prior context; record the voice decision and end the Session; restart Connect and resume with a follow-up Message that uses the decision. Verify one conversation timeline, session/provider bindings, no duplicate effects and no context leakage to another conversation. Reject ambiguous context binding and do not silently contact another route after a timeout. The approved SMS path now carries real conversation turns and native SDK recall; finish live HELP/STOP/START enforcement.

features.required_capability: Route-aware capabilities and session invitations
features.status: Gate 3 qualifies authenticated session invitations, terminal replay, availability and explicit media bindings. Broader video/tools remain later work.
features.required_evidence: Resolve permitted routes/limits; explicit unsupported operation; invite/accept/reject/end with authority and observable state.

features.required_capability: Independent UCTP implementation and protocol conformance
features.status: Wire contract and fixtures exist; independent implementation remains unqualified.
features.required_evidence: Versioned profile and fixtures allow an independently written client to negotiate, authenticate, exchange requests/events and reject incompatible operations.

features.required_capability: Account/resource setup, protected secrets and verified contacts
features.status: Provisioning/readback exists; complete designed setup experience remains planned.
features.required_evidence: Select resources, preview changes, resume interrupted setup, verify contact ownership and report separate inbound/outbound readiness. Qualify the selected ingress/secret-store approach.

features.required_capability: Measured operating envelope and failure/recovery behavior
features.status: Gate 3 qualifies one/four-session 60-second profiles, real RTP reorder/loss, bounded queues, expiry, saturation, peer/server cancellation, recovery and local installed packages. Full platform/release envelope remains Gate 5.
features.required_evidence: Document and test retention, file size, concurrency, loss/latency, cancellation, restart, uncertain effects and diagnostics for advertised paths.

features.required_capability: Scoped authority across files, media, tools and app actions
features.status: Gate 3 current authority/revocation/isolation checks pass for sessions, availability, artifacts, SIP and WebRTC. Later tools/app/video require their own checks.
features.required_evidence: Enforce current authorization and revocation on all added operations. Prevent cross-task/context leakage, spoofed caller authority and unauthorized file access; no per-action permission console.

features.required_capability: Two complete first-run journeys
features.status: Native app loop and provider chat/telephone portions qualified; full journeys incomplete.
features.required_evidence: A new developer completes both give-an-agent-presence and make-an-app-reachable, including independently initiated communication, artifact/reply handling and restart. Measure setup usability.

upstream.status: All checked items open; next release adoption not guaranteed

assignment_status: Gate 3: 35 tasks and 13 required criteria qualified on the recorded topology. Immediate repairs and installed package verified. SMS conversation/native recall passed; keyword qualification remains open. Gate 4 tools and Gate 5 full v0.1 remain planned.
